runbill v0.2.0

- `runbill org ORG`: roll up Actions cost across every repo of an org or user, ranked by cost. Skips archived repos by default; `--max-runs` is per repo (default 200). Respects `--days` / `--since` / `--top` / `--rate` / `--format` / `--fail-over`.

Action: `uses: Blackman99/runbill@v0.2.0` · Install: `pipx install git+https://github.com/Blackman99/runbill@v0.2.0` · Docs: https://blackman99.github.io/runbill/docs/
